prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In Step After Adoption: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users personalize their pet before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial: Add a new desktop controls guide screen immediately after initial home intro.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_guide"], "new_controls_guide": {"headline": "Mastering Desktop Pet Controls", "body": "Learn how to summon, move, and talk with your companion anywhere on your desktop screen.", "layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Right-click your pet anytime to access quick actions and settings.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Split Layout Companion Showcase: Redesign the companion selection screen into a split layout with animated preview cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your New Companion", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Companion", "style": "playful"}, {"role": "pet_choices", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Pet Mascot Waiting Flow: Add an interactive pet mascot animation and tip carousel to engage users during background setup.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's New Home", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:waiting_mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Fun tips while your pet gets ready", "style": "calm"}]}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Benefit Copy: Clarify path options with explicit benefits comparing pre-made pets vs custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose How to Begin", "body": "Select a ready-to-adopt companion for instant desktop fun, or create your own custom pet avatar from scratch."}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Sign-In Hint: Add a prominent hint explaining how signing in saves pet customization securely.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in links your desktop pet to your account so your progress and customizations are saved safely."}}
6: [adoption, layout] Spotlight Adoption Certificate Layout: Switch adoption certificate view to spotlight layout with full progress display.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "show_progress": true}}
7: [home, wait_info] Visual Progress Timer on Waiting Screen: Add an explicit progress bar and estimated completion timer to the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Setting up desktop environment...", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "timer", "label": "Estimated time remaining", "style": "subtle"}]}}
8: [finish, incentive] Starter Accessory Welcome Incentive: Display a free accessory unlock badge and celebratory animation on the welcome screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Family!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlocked: Free Starter Accessory Pack", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:confetti", "style": "playful"}]}}
9: [choose_path, notification] Background Readiness Notification Option: Enable time estimates and desktop ready notifications during initial story intro.
   config: {"story": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
